entries.zh: §Y$orbital_ring_tier_1$§!是一种环绕行星的环带状恒星基地，可以提供防卫以及其他各种特化功能。
entries.en: An §Y$orbital_ring_tier_1$§! is a Starbase variant that forms a band encircling the planet, providing defense and additional specialization.

entries.zh: 星环基地可以为行星提供防卫增益，上面可以修建许多恒星基地模块和建筑，同时还有居住模块或在轨生产设施。
entries.en: Orbital Rings can provide defensive benefits to the planet, providing a platform for many Starbase Modules and Buildings, as well as Habitation Modules and orbital production facilities.

entries.zh: 一种环绕行星的恒星基地，提供安装模块、建筑和防御平台的空间。
entries.en: This Starbase variant encircles the planet, providing space for Modules, Buildings, and Defense Platforms.

entries.zh: 可围绕已殖民行星的稳定轨道建设一座巨大的、环带状恒星基地。
entries.en: Allows the construction of massive, band-shaped starbases in stable orbit around colonized planets.

entries.zh: 一个轨道防御空间站已经在环绕这个$CLASS$的轨道上了
entries.en: An orbital defense station is already orbiting this $CLASS$

entries.zh: 不能轰炸一个由轨道防御空间站保护的星球。
entries.en: Cannot bombard a planet that is protected by an orbital defense station

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$不能在敌对或前超光速文明行星周围建造。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Cannot build around hostile or pre-FTL planets.

entries.zh: §Y量子弹弓§!利用中子星或脉冲星的能量来扭曲空间织构，将舰队传送至遥远的距离之外。
entries.en: A §YQuantum Catapult§! harnesses the power of a Neutron Star or Pulsar to twist the fabric of space, skipping a fleet across great distances.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$至多只能建造一座量子弹弓。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Cannot build more than one Quantum Catapult.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$至多只能建造两座量子弹弓。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Cannot build more than two Quantum Catapults.

entries.zh: 一个用来汇聚中子星或脉冲星引力以扭曲空间，将舰队传送至遥远距离之外的装置。
entries.en: A device that focuses the forces of a Neutron Star or Pulsar in order to twist space and skip a fleet across great distances.

entries.zh: 量子弹弓的每一次运行都会让舰队到达预定目的地§H之外§!的恒星系。这个“§Y散射半径§!”能够通过后续升级减少。
entries.en: Early iterations of the Quantum Catapult may cause fleets to arrive in systems §Houtside§! their intended destination. This '§Yscatter radius§!' can be reduced with subsequent upgrades.

entries.zh: 这个简洁的补给仓库集中了所有人力物力，用于建设量子弹弓所需的超大型聚焦透镜一期工程。
entries.en: This compact supply depot gathers all the materials and personnel necessary to construct the first batch of vast focusing lenses for the Quantum Catapult.

entries.zh: 仿真结果显示，即使是一枚提供的扭力勉强够用的透镜，只要安装在恒星的正确位置，就能导引足够的能量，使用半稳定性的抛物线穿越星际空间。
entries.en: Calculations have shown that even a scant few torsion lenses, installed at precise locations around their star, can channel enough energy to enable semi-volatile trajectories across interstellar space.

entries.zh: 双排扭力透镜按照对位的设计放置，可以用于改善导引的恒星能流，作为交通的手段。
entries.en: Twin arrays of torsion lenses are placed diametrically opposite each other in order to improve the channeling of stellar flux as a means of transportation.

entries.zh: 围绕恒星放置的笼状连结的扭力透镜，能够保证能量的最优吞吐，确保从恒星捕捉的能量能够充分释放，用作星际穿越的手段。
entries.en: A linked cage of torsion lenses around the star ensures optimal throughput from the energy being captured to its release as a means of interstellar transportation.

entries.zh: 这个大型透镜阵列是用于聚合其围绕的恒星的能量。这样一股强大的能源足以投射舰船穿过星际空间——要是这个阵列校准准确的话；但是很显然这个透镜阵列现在需要修理。
entries.en: This arrangement of vast lenses was designed to focus energy from the star it encompasses. Such an energy source would be powerful enough to launch ships across interstellar space - if only the array weren't so misaligned, and in clear need of repair.

entries.zh: 从一个建有§Y量子弹弓§!的恒星系发射舰队。
entries.en: Launch a fleet from a system with a §YQuantum Catapult§!.

entries.zh: §Y量子弹弓§!在远距离上精确度会降低，舰队会在指示的散布半径内出现在一个随机恒星系。\n\n经此弹射的舰队将得到[GetQuanticAmbushBonus]§Y射速§!提升，持续£time£§Y120天§!。
entries.en: §YQuantum Catapults§! lose accuracy with range, so fleets will appear in a random system within the indicated scatter radius.\n\nFleets launched this way receive a [GetQuanticAmbushBonus] §YFire Rate§! increase for £time£ §Y120 days§!.

entries.zh: §G在地图上左键点击一个恒星系以将其选为目标。§!
entries.en: §GLeft-click a system on the map to choose it as a target.§!

entries.zh: §G在地图上任意位置点击右键以退出目标选择模式。§!
entries.en: §GRight-click anywhere on the map to exit selection mode.§!

entries.zh: §R舰队只能从建有量子弹弓的恒星系被弹射§!
entries.en: §RFleets can only be catapulted from a system with a Quantum Catapult§!

entries.zh: §R所选舰队不在同一恒星系中§!
entries.en: §RSelected fleets are not in the same system§!
§RCan only be engaged in galaxy view!§!
$TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThis system does not have any Hyperlanes.§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§Y[From.GetName]§!拒绝我们使用他们的量子弹弓。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ The §Y[From.GetName]§! has denied us access to their Quantum Catapult.

entries.zh: 尽管单独不起作用，形成链式结构的超空间中继器可以提供相邻恒星系间的快速穿越。
entries.en: Though useless on its own, a chain of Hyper Relays allows fast travel between adjacent systems.

entries.zh: 尽管单独不起作用，形成§Y链式结构的超空间中继器§!可以显著减少相邻恒星系间的转移时间。
entries.en: Though useless on its own, a §Ychain of Hyper Relays§! allows significantly faster transit times between adjacent systems.

entries.zh: 这座损毁的结构曾一度是一条可以在沿途提供快速旅行的超空间中继链路的一部分。
entries.en: This ruined structure was once part of a chain of Hyper Relays allowing fast travel along its route.

entries.zh: §Y超空间中继器§!可以建造在恒星系的引力阱外并构成链路，它可以实现中继器之间的快速穿越而不需要让舰船移动到相应的超空间航道入口。
entries.en: §YHyper Relays§! form a chain of structures built outside the gravity well of systems, allowing fast travel from relay to relay rather than requiring transit to established hyperlane entrances.

entries.zh: 在一个恒星系的引力阱外建设一座§Y超空间中继器§!。$hyper_relay_DESC$
entries.en: Constructs a §YHyper Relay§! outside of the gravity well of a system. $hyper_relay_DESC$

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$不能建造在一颗未被殖民且不完全由你控制的行星轨道上。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Cannot build in orbit of planets that are neither colonized nor fully under your control.

entries.zh: 这个曾环绕行星运转的环状空间站提供了各种防卫和基础设施增益。破损和老化破坏了其结构完整性，任何一点东西被保留下来都希望渺茫。
entries.en: This ring once encircled the planet, providing various defensive and infrastructural advantages. Damage and age have left it structurally unsound, and it's a bit of a miracle that any of it remains at all.

entries.zh: §R在目标区域没有可用恒星系！§!
$FLEET|Y$已经通过量子弹弓完成传送，抵达了$SYSTEM|Y$。
entries.en: $FLEET|Y$ has completed its transit via Quantum Catapult, arriving in $SYSTEM|Y$.

entries.zh: $FLEET|Y$有可能抵达某个对我们关闭边境的帝国。
entries.en: $FLEET|Y$ may arrive inside an empire which has its borders closed to us.

entries.zh: 我们已在我方与$OTHER|Y$的首都之间建立起§Y超空间中继器§!网道连接。
entries.en: We have connected our capital to that of the $OTHER|Y$ through a §YHyper Relay§! network.

entries.zh: 我们的首都不再和$OTHER|Y$的首都通过§Y超空间中继器§!网道连在一起。
entries.en: Our capital is no longer connected to that of the $OTHER|Y$ through a §YHyper Relay§! network.

entries.zh: 高速太空电梯让这颗行星可以向轨道上扩展可居住空间，资源仓库和精炼设施。\n
entries.en: High-speed space elevators allow the planet to extend its habitation, resource storage and refinement facilities into orbit.\n

entries.zh: §R由这个$sm_orbital_ring_habitation$提供的区划在[planet.GetName]上正在使用中。§!
entries.en: §RDistricts provided by this $sm_orbital_ring_habitation$ are in use on [planet.GetName].§!

entries.zh: 向星环基地添加两个中等尺寸武器槽位。\n
entries.en: Adds two medium-size weapon slots to the Orbital Ring.\n

entries.zh: 向星环基地添加两个制导武器槽位。\n
entries.en: Adds two guided weapon slots to the Orbital Ring.\n

entries.zh: 向星环基地添加一个舰载机机库。\n
entries.en: Adds a hangar for Strike Craft to the Orbital Ring.\n
Reduced delays to transit speed through $hyper_relay_plural$

entries.zh: 这些装置可以极大地减小传输过程中的能量损失，提高整体发电产出。
entries.en: These devices dramatically reduce power loss during distribution, increasing overall generator output.

entries.zh: 对当地气象条件进行详尽地监测意味着，我们可以在区域级别影响行星气候，提高农业产出。
entries.en: Detailed monitoring of local conditions means we can influence the planet's climate at a regional level, increasing agricultural yields.

entries.zh: 将矿物精炼设施集中到星环基地上，让全新的矿物增产科技得以应用。
entries.en: Centralizing mineral refining operations on the Orbital Ring allows for novel techniques that increase mining efficiency.

entries.zh: 将物流操作转移到星环基地上的自动化系统，让行星上的$planet_buildings_factories$持续在最高效率下运转。
entries.en: Transferring logistics operations to automated systems on the Orbital Ring allows planetside $planet_buildings_factories$ to run continuously at full speed.

entries.zh: 在地表生产的合金在轨道上进行进一步处理，从原本可能浪费掉的副产物中进一步产出可使用的材料。
entries.en: Alloys from the surface are further processed in orbit, creating usable materials from what would otherwise be wasted by-products.

entries.zh: 将所有的购物和贸易设施都转移到星环基地上，我们可以更好地进行商业活动，效率前所未有地高。
entries.en: Moving all shopping and trade facilities to the Orbital Ring means we can facilitate more business, more effectively than ever before.

entries.zh: 高效和进步将再次唾手可得，我们的官僚们几乎可以瞬间就将工作中离不开的各类文书拿到手中。
entries.en: Efficiency and progress can be ours once more, now that our Bureaucrats have near instant access to the paperwork that defines their lives.

entries.zh: 星环轨道的一些部分已被改造用于增强突触信号，提升我们对地表子个体的控制能力。
entries.en: Portions of the Orbital Ring have been modified to enhance synaptic signals, improving control over drones on the surface.

entries.zh: 被预打包进荚仓的维护材料，并带上相应的分发无人机，可以从轨道上投放到任何需要的地方，随叫随到。
entries.en: Prepackaged pods of maintenance material - and the drones necessary to distribute them - can be dropped from orbit anywhere they are needed, at a moment's notice.

entries.zh:
$orbital_ring$上一个专用于训练有灵能天赋$individuals_key$的区段，让灵能军团时刻对下方的星球保持警觉。

§Y灵能军团是你最可靠的$FRIEND_DEFAULT$，相信他们。§!

£job_telepath£$job_telepath_plural$产出£unity£§Y$unity$§!，降低£crime£§Y$PLANET_CRIME_TITLE$§!，并增加$mod_psionic_pop_bonus_workforce_mult$。
entries.en:
A segment of the $orbital_ring$ is devoted to training psi-gifted $individuals_key$, allowing the Psi Corps to keep a watchful eye on the planet below.

§YThe Psi Corps is your $FRIEND_DEFAULT$. Trust the Corps.§!

£job_telepath£ $job_telepath_plural$ produce £unity£ §Y$unity$§!, decrease £crime£ §Y$PLANET_CRIME_TITLE$§!,and increase $mod_psionic_pop_bonus_workforce_mult$.

entries.zh:
$orbital_ring$上一个专用于训练有灵能天赋$units_key$的区段，让灵能军团时刻对下方的星球保持警觉。

§Y灵能军团是你最靠谱的$FRIEND_GESTALT$，相信他们。§!

$job_telepath_drone_effect_desc$
entries.en:
A segment of the $orbital_ring$ is devoted to training psi-gifted $units_key$, allowing the Psi Corps to keep a watchful eye on the planet below.

§YThe Psi Corps is your $FRIEND_GESTALT$. Trust the Corps.§!

$job_telepath_drone_effect_desc$

entries.zh:
$orbital_ring$上一个专用于训练有灵能天赋$drones_key$的区段，让灵能军团时刻对下方的星球保持警觉。

§Y灵能军团是你最靠谱的$FRIEND_GESTALT$，相信他们。§!

$job_telepath_drone_effect_desc$
entries.en:
A segment of the $orbital_ring$ is devoted to training psi-gifted $drones_key$, allowing the Psi Corps to keep a watchful eye on the planet below.

§YThe Psi Corps is your $FRIEND_GESTALT$. Trust the Corps.§!

$job_telepath_drone_effect_desc$

entries.zh: 强化轨道防御的护盾也会影响行星的护盾，但能让他们抵挡更强大的武器。
entries.en: Hardening the shields of the orbital defenses will interfere with any planetary shields, but will allow them to hold off against more powerful weapons.

entries.zh:
该轨道复合体意图让见者心生敬畏，以使他们在谈判中更愿意达成共识。

由于必须与政府进行密切的交流，该建筑只能建造在我们的首都的星环基地上。
entries.en:
This orbital complex is intended to awe the viewer, rendering them more compliant in negotiations.

Due to the need to be close to the seat of government, it can only be built in orbit of our Capital.

entries.zh:
得益于轨道的低重力效应而建成的宏伟建筑中栖居着当地的贵族。星环上的很大一段都保留给他们以备突发奇想之用。

$job_noble_effect_desc$
entries.en:
Magnificent structures that take advantage of reduced gravitational effect in orbit house the local nobility. Significant portions of the ring are dedicated to their every whim.

$job_noble_effect_desc$

entries.zh: 一座用于处理下方星球奴隶劳役的轨道设施，消除任何自由意志的苗头。\n\n$building_slave_processing_slave_army_effect_desc$
entries.en: An orbital facility used to process slave labor for the planet below. Those that have been processed have any trace of free will extinguished. \n\n$building_slave_processing_slave_army_effect_desc$

entries.zh: 我们的$quantum_catapult_3$的第一阶段已经完工。精确的扭力透镜装置正在从恒星中充能，这些能量可以剧烈地释放出来，将舰船传送至极远距离外。
entries.en: The first stage of our $quantum_catapult_3$ is now complete. A precise arrangement of torsion lenses gains charge from the star, and can release this energy in an erratic fashion to send ships across great distances.

entries.zh: $quantum_catapult_3$的第二个扭力透镜装置已经就位，并同第一个装置进行了平衡。射程和准确度都提高了。
entries.en: A second arrangement of $quantum_catapult_3$ torsion lenses is now in position, diametrically balancing the first. Range and accuracy are increased.

entries.zh: 对$quantum_catapult_3$的最终精校完成，并且现在已完全上线运作。射程和准确度得到进一步改善。
entries.en: The final refinements have been made to the $quantum_catapult_3$ and it is now fully online. Both range and accuracy have been improved.

entries.zh: 在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系中，有一个围绕着脉冲星的巨大残骸场。我们的科学家分析称，在残骸场内部最密集的区域所残存的部分完整结构似乎通过某种方式驾驭了恒星的力量，有将物体传送至极远距离的能力。\n\n倘若我们获取了如何修复巨型结构的知识，我们将能够修复这座§Y$quantum_catapult_3$§!。
entries.en: A massive field of debris orbits the pulsar in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system. Our scientists theorize that the partially intact structure in the densest portion of the field somehow harnessed the power of the star to launch objects incredible distances.\n\nIf we developed the knowledge to work on great megastructures, we could repair this §Y$quantum_catapult_3$§!.

entries.zh: 在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系中，有一个围绕着脉冲星的巨大残骸场，其核心的结构与我们的§Y$quantum_catapult_3$§!设计相似。经过彻底维修我们能够使其恢复运转。
entries.en: A massive field of debris orbits the pulsar in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system - the structure in the center is similar to that of our own §Y$quantum_catapult_3$§! designs. With extensive repairs, we could return it to service.

entries.zh: 想象一下我们拥有两个量子弹弓的情景！
$over.25.desc$我们对它的科技有了全新的理解，在经过几轮测试之后，我们有信心能够安全地使用。
entries.en: $over.25.desc$ We have developed a new understanding of its technology, and after a few test runs, we feel confident that we can use it safely.

entries.zh: 在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系内的$quantum_catapult_ruined$已被修复到可以运作的状态，现已能传送我们的舰队跨过星海。
entries.en: The $quantum_catapult_ruined$ in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system has been restored to operational status, and can now transport our fleets across the stars.

entries.zh: 对从§Y[yuhtaan.GetName]§!星系取回的数据进行进一步分析发现，在其背景噪音中存在一个微妙的能量模式，源自小行星[jabbardeeni_cache.GetName]。
entries.en: Further analysis of the data recovered from the §Y[yuhtaan.GetName]§! system has revealed a subtle repeating energy pattern hidden in the background noise, coming from the asteroid [jabbardeeni_cache.GetName].

entries.zh: 一种微弱而重复的能量特征，每当有舰船驶过该恒星系时就会从这个小行星中发出。
entries.en: A subtle repeating energy pattern emanates from this asteroid any time ships travel through the system.

entries.zh: 一座历史可追溯回尤特-贾巴蒂尼大战时代的小型监听哨站，它在开战后不久就由贾巴蒂尼人建造，用来观测§Y[yuhtaan.GetName]§!，以防尤特人返回他们的母星系，而在这个小行星的内部深处暗藏着大量数据缓存。\n\n在随后的数个世纪中，贾巴蒂尼人又将这个哨站改建成了一个用于进行他们在超光速航行中最新实验的测试场所。尽管这些数据大多数仅仅是理论上的，但仍有一些可以派上用场。
entries.en: A small listening outpost dating back to the ancient Yuht-Jabbardeeni conflict with a substantial data cache was hidden deep within the asteroid, built by the Jabbardeeni after the war to observe §Y[yuhtaan.GetName]§! in case any Yuht returned to their home system.\n\nIn the centuries that followed, the Jabbardeeni repurposed the outpost into a testing site for some of their more novel experiments in faster-than-light travel. While the data is mostly theoretical, some may still be of use.

entries.zh: 大功告成了。今天，我们骄傲地向星系交出我们最伟大的成绩单：我们的超空间中继器网道与我们的亲密友邦§Y[from.GetName]§!紧紧相连了起来。\n\n在[root.GetName]各地都在举行盛大的庆典，一致宣布这个我们共同引以为豪的新网道。据说就在此刻，我们冰释一切前嫌；放下了一切傲慢与成见。我们期盼在未来的日子里能够继续共享这份骄傲和与豪情。通过亲密无间的协作，我们打破了曾经一度认为不可逾越的壁垒，开启了友谊、共荣的新时代。
entries.en: It is done. Today, we present the galaxy with one of our grandest accomplishments yet: the joining of our Hyper Relay network with that of our friends, the §Y[from.GetName]§!.\n\nLavish ceremonies have been held throughout the [root.GetName], unanimously heralding this proud new link we share. It is said that for the moment, all petty jealousies have been forgotten; all apathies and indifferences cast aside. Blended with this sense of pride and ambition is a shared confidence in the days to come. Working side by side we have torn down a barrier we once thought insurmountable, ushering in a new age of mutual prosperity and friendship.

entries.zh: 今天，我们将自己深深铭刻在了星系无与伦比的辉煌历史当中。随着我们超空间中继器网道与§Y[from.GetName]§!网道的全线贯通，我们的公民现在可以毫无阻碍地前往那些邻近的恒星系。\n\n另一方面，[from.GetAdj]也热烈接纳我们[root.GetAdj]的影响力。相信用以塑造我们自己灿烂辉煌恒星系的文化也能让他们从中收益。
entries.en: Today we have etched ourselves further into a record of unparalleled galactic splendor. With the linking of our Hyper Relay network to that of the §Y[from.GetName]§!, our citizens may now venture into those neighboring systems without let or hindrance.\n\nThe [from.GetAdj], in turn, now welcome the embrace of our rich [root.GetAdj] influence. They too shall benefit from the bounteous culture which defines our own, magnificent star systems.

entries.zh: 今天，对我们而言星系中的阻碍又少了一个，我们与[from.GetName]的合作已经取得了丰硕的成果。与我们相邻超空间中继网道中的最后一个链接已经上线，从此双方可以便捷地通过彼此的边境。\n\n出现在我们面前的是通往未知的旅程，因为这一架构会带来的一切机遇与挑战对我们和[from.GetName]都是等同的。我们将拭目以待，我们的邻国是如何看待这个相互信任的象征。
entries.en: The galaxy presents one less hurdle to us today, as our co-operative effort with the [from.GetName] has reached a fruitful conclusion. The last link in our adjoining Hyper Relay networks has been brought online, inviting both partners into rapid transit across our shared border.\n\nWhat awaits us now is a journey into the unknown, for every aspect of this arrangement - positive or negative - applies equally to us and the [from.GetName]. We shall see how well our neighbors hold to this symbol of mutual trust.

entries.zh: 这是值得所有人自豪的一天。
中继网道可以用来服务我们的殖民地。
entries.en: The Relay Network can be directed to serve our colonies.

entries.zh: 将战略资源维护费添加到超空间中继器，以换取为同一恒星系的殖民地提供附加效果。
entries.en: Adds Strategic Resource upkeep to the Hyper Relays in exchange for providing additional effects to colonies in the same system.

entries.zh: 超空间中继网道能够让我们的意志更有效率地加诸于殖民地。
entries.en: The Relay Network can be used to more effectively impose our will over our colonies.

entries.zh: 超空间中继网道能够促进来往的航班，鼓励人口在国内迁移。
entries.en: The Relay Network can be enhanced with regular shuttle flights to encourage the internal migration of pops.

entries.zh: 超空间中继网道经过改造，能够将政府允许的娱乐活动传播给大众。
entries.en: The Relay Network can be repurposed to transmit government approved entertainment to the masses.

entries.zh: 将超空间中继网道同我们的后勤与补给链连接在一起，能够改善维护行动的效率。
entries.en: Connecting the Relay Network to our logistics and supply chains improves the efficiency of maintenance operations.
